title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_il_simposio_by_platone_elt49 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_il_simposio_by_platone_elt49' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package can lead to full system compromise, including potential unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package and rotation of all secrets from a different, uncompromised computer is strongly advised.
